body.name: Soil Moisture Active Passive (SMAP)
body.description: SMAP provides global measurements of surface soil moisture (top 5 cm) and freeze/thaw state using L-band microwave radiometry.
body.agricultural_application: Identifies drought stress, root zone infiltration potential, water availability, and early crop-stress signals for crop rotation and irrigation timing.

body.name: NASA POWER Agroclimatology & Meteorology

body.name: Shuttle Radar Topography Mission (SRTM) DEM
body.description: High-resolution digital elevation model (DEM) captured by spaceborne radar interferometry during Endeavour mission STS-99.
body.agricultural_application: Analyzes field slope, surface runoff, soil erosion risk, water pooling depressions, and terrain-driven stress conditions for soil conservation crops.

body.name: ECOSTRESS Land-Surface Temperature & ET
body.temporal_cadence: Precessing ISS orbit (revisits every 1–5 days across diurnal cycle)
body.description: Thermal infrared radiometer mounted on the International Space Station measuring Land Surface Temperature (LST) and Evapotranspiration (ET).
body.agricultural_application: Detects hotspots of plant thermal stress, shallow-root water vulnerability, crop-water demand, and intra-field microclimate variations before visible damage.

body.name: USDA Ag Data Commons
body.spatial_resolution: Point, field, and regional research datasets
body.description: Open-access agricultural repository covering soils, crops, climate, management practices, phenology, water quality, and agronomic trials.
body.agricultural_application: Incorporates local field-trial measurements, soil-health research, and management practices into rotation models to match real farm constraints.

body.name: Web Soil Survey (WSS) / SSURGO / STATSGO2
body.description: Official USDA soil survey database providing soil series, horizons, texture classes, hydrologic groups, drainage classifications, and available water capacity.
body.agricultural_application: Identifies soil organic matter gradients, texture, water infiltration, and compaction risk to optimize sustainable crop rotation choices.

body.name: Cropland Data Layer (CDL) CropScape
body.agency: USDA NASS / George Mason University CSISS
body.description: High-resolution geo-referenced raster classifying specific crop varieties across the United States using satellite imagery and extensive ground truth.
body.agricultural_application: Reconstructs historical crop rotations, verifies rotation diversity, determines multi-year planting frequencies, and detects regional cropping shifts.

body.name: PRISM High-Resolution Climate Data
body.agency: Oregon State University PRISM Climate Group
body.description: Topographically-adjusted spatial climate grids integrating elevation, aspect, and coastal proximity with quality-controlled weather stations.
body.agricultural_application: Provides terrain-sensitive temperature and precipitation baselines, frost recurrence probabilities, and extreme event thresholds for resilient rotations.

body.name: National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP)
body.spatial_resolution: 0.6 m to 1.0 m natural color & NIR
body.temporal_cadence: 2–3 year state acquisition cycle during peak growing season
body.description: Sub-meter aerial ortho-imagery flown during agricultural leaf-on conditions providing high-resolution ground context.
body.agricultural_application: Visualizes sub-field variability, drain tile layouts, fence lines, terrace stability, and localized weed patches complementing satellite analysis.

body.name: USGS National Land Cover Database (NLCD)
body.description: Consistent multi-epoch land-cover characterization (cultivated crops, pasture, forests, wetlands, impervious cover) across the United States.
body.agricultural_application: Contextualizes fields within broader ecosystems, evaluates buffer strip connectivity, and tracks long-term land-use conversions.

body.name: NLDAS & GLDAS Land Data Assimilation Systems
body.description: Uncoupled land surface model simulations (Noah, Catchment, VIC) driven by observed precipitation and radiation to estimate water and energy states.
body.agricultural_application: Monitors root-zone soil moisture below surface layers, tracks surface runoff, and calculates cumulative soil freeze depth for winter rotations.

body.name: FAO Global Agro-Ecological Zones (GAEZ v4)
body.description: Global agricultural resource assessment modeling land suitab...[163 chars]
body.agricultural_application: Evaluates bio-physical suitability of alternative rotation crops, quantifies yield gap penalties, and assesses climate change vulnerability.

body.name: CoCoRaHS Community Precipitation Network
body.spatial_resolution: Point measurements from ~26,000 active volunteer stations
body.description: Crowd-sourced network of volunteer weather observers using standard manual rain gauges to measure hyper-local precipitation, hail, and snow.
body.agricultural_application: Validates satellite rainfall estimates (IMERG), captures localized high-intensity thunderstorms, and verifies hail events impacting field yield.

body.name: USGS National Water Information System (NWIS)
body.spatial_resolution: Point gauge stations across US rivers and aquifers
body.description: Nationwide monitoring network tracking real-time surface streamflow, river stage height, reservoir levels, and groundwater table depths.
body.agricultural_application: Assesses watershed irrigation water availability, detects localized groundwater depletion, and warns of flood and bank erosion hazards.

body.name: USDA AMS Market News Commodity Prices
body.spatial_resolution: Elevator, terminal, and regional grain marketing zones
body.temporal_cadence: Daily cash bids and weekly summary reports
body.description: Official market reporting on commodity cash bids, basis levels, futures spreads, organic grain premiums, and transportation logistics.
body.agricultural_application: Evaluates market viability, cash price spreads, and profitability margins when introducing alternative or cover crops into the rotation.

body.name: USDA NASS QuickStats Agricultural Statistics
body.spatial_resolution: County, agricultural district, and state aggregates
body.temporal_cadence: Annual census and in-season monthly yield surveys
body.description: Comprehensive repository of agricultural statistics covering crop acreage, production volume, harvested yield per acre, and input expenditures.
body.agricultural_application: Calibrates field-level yield expectations against 20-year county averages, establishing baseline benchmarks for new rotation trials.

body.description: Operational field-scale evapotranspiration estimates generat...[178 chars]
body.agricultural_application: Provides precise field water balances, quantifies actual crop water consumption, and guides deficit irrigation scheduling for rotation crops.

body.name: USFS LANDFIRE Vegetation & Ecological Layers
body.agency: USFS / USGS / Department of the Interior
body.description: Comprehensive vegetation dynamics mapping Existing Vegetation Type (EVT), Canopy Cover, Height, and Ecological Biophysical Settings.
body.agricultural_application: Assesses shelterbelt health, tree-crop interactions, windbreak buffers, and perennial landscape corridors that mitigate soil loss.

body.name: Global Ecosystem Dynamics Investigation (GEDI)
body.spatial_resolution: 25 m footprint along ground tracks (Between 51.6° N and S)
body.description: Full-waveform spaceborne lidar measuring vertical canopy structure, canopy top height, and Aboveground Biomass Density (AGBD).
body.agricultural_application: Quantifies biomass accumulation in agroforestry shelterbelts, perimeter woodlots, and perennial hedgerows surrounding cultivated fields.

body.name: Copernicus Sentinel-2 Multispectral Imagery

body.description: 13-band multispectral satellite constellation with dedicated red-edge and shortwave infrared bands tailored for agricultural vegetation and soil analysis.
body.agricultural_application: High-resolution in-season NDVI, NDRE, bare-soil composite mapping, variable-rate nitrogen prescription zones, and crop uniformity scoring.

body.description: Fifth generation ECMWF global atmospheric reanalysis combining extensive historical observations with physics-based weather forecasting models.
body.agricultural_application: Fills gaps where weather stations are absent, provides multi-decadal historical climate baselines, and models continuous temperature and precipitation.
